nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Introduces Chapter 15 and outlines the directory structure for systematic troubleshooting decision trees, high-concurrency diagnostic paths, and operational best practices.
nodes.languageNotes: Serves as the chapter roadmap linking to layered troubleshooting trees, high-concurrency diagnosis, and appendix checklists.

nodes.name: 15.1_diagnostic_decision_trees.md
nodes.summary: Establishes a 6-tier diagnostic decision tree framework covering startup, messaging gateway, model invocation, tool execution, session/memory, and performance degradation, guided by evidence chain hypothesis elimination.
nodes.languageNotes: Details Mermaid-based binary triage decision trees for 6 distinct architectural layers, pairing each branch with specific CLI verification commands.

nodes.name: 15.2_high_concurrency_diagnosis.md
nodes.summary: Provides diagnostic decision trees and mitigation strategies for high-concurrency production incidents, addressing HTTP 429 rate limiting, authentication expiration, token budget exhaustion, queue overflows, and cascading system failures.
nodes.languageNotes: Covers five targeted diagnostic routes, real-world post-mortems, circuit breaking, token rate limits, and exponential backoff retry policies.

nodes.name: summary.md
nodes.summary: Summarizes the key concepts of Chapter 15, emphasizing binary triage, proactive health checks via openclaw doctor, high-concurrency circuit breakers, and scheduled operational auditing.
nodes.languageNotes: Recaps binary triage rules, openclaw doctor --deep diagnostic routines, and operational health metrics before pointing to Chapter 16.
